First community release of Simple Memo.

- Local memos stored in daily Markdown notes.
- Markdown preview, tasks, tags, search, calendar, heatmap, and attachments.
- Pinning, archiving, random review, drafts, and a recoverable recycle bin.
- Thino daily-note compatibility and automatic settings migration from earlier local Simple Memo installations.

Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. Tested on macOS with Obsidian 1.14.4; mobile-device testing is still pending. The interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.

For manual installation, extract the ZIP into your vault's `.obsidian/plugins/` folder and enable Simple Memo. Existing `simple-thino` users should disable the old plugin before enabling this release; settings, drafts, and recycle-bin entries are copied while the original files are preserved.
